text: I'm Lisa Negiza from Indonesia and I'm so excited to be here today with you to talk about your regarding upcoming movie Captain America Brave New World. So should we get into the questions? Knock it out! So first of all the release of Captain America Brave New World is surely a long-awaited moment for fans around the world including me and the teaser I watched it alone is so intense, action-packed and super fun and also gives MCU a fresh new look for me. It's overall very amazing but first of all I want to ask you personally what was the most amazing thing about this movie and also is there anything new that's never been done before? I would say the most amazing thing is reconnecting with old friends. Tim Blake Nelson and Giancarlo Esposito are two people I've admired through my entire career and starting in the New York theater scene I've known them for a very long time so I was very happy to hear Tim was coming back and you know once we got Giancarlo it was I mean you can't ask for a better opportunity to work with two of your old friends you know so that was that was great it was exciting because you know I've never been able to chop it up with them on the boards and now I had the opportunity to request them and get them in my movie. That's amazing so you've been obviously evolving with the character for about a decade now so from Falcon to Captain America what was the most challenging and also what do you feel by the character development and what changed the most? The biggest challenge was not being able to have as much fun when I was Falcon Falcon was there with Captain America so all of it was new and fresh to him all of it he had never you know shot down aliens or done anything like that before his world was very small and specific to where to DC and work with soldiers and being a counselor and a patriot but then once the band-aid was pulled off and he got to see the difference in what was behind the curtain it changed everything he realized the intensity of the universe around him and what his job was to not only save his community but to save the world so there was a certain gravitas and weight to that and it really changed the perspective of the character in the universe. The action sequences in this movie because I got a new suit from Wakanda the stuff that I'm able to do the action sequences the fights that I'm able to have is unlike anything you've seen Steve Rogers do is unlike anything you've seen anybody in the MCU do because I have wings I have the ability to shoot fight kick and you know do all this stuff.
